claim_boundary: This manifest composes accepted native and diagnostic-desktop consumers into an offline foundation proof. It grants no new renderer, provider, credential, path, command, network, evaluator, semantic-oracle, or M2 authority and is not a production-readiness guarantee.

workflow.action: Bootstrap the application and negotiate exact contract versions and fingerprints.
workflow.failure_boundary: Unknown versions, fingerprints, message shapes, sessions, or sequence domains fail closed before state is accepted.

workflow.action: Detect installed tools and expose typed capability gaps without inventing availability.
workflow.failure_boundary: Missing or invalid tools remain explicit gaps; no implicit path, launch, or renderer authority is created.

workflow.action: Select one profile explicitly and retain its typed identity.
workflow.failure_boundary: Ambiguous, stale, missing, or unconfirmed profile selection cannot become effective run state.

workflow.action: Create or select a revisioned saved scan configuration and preserve immutable effective run values.
workflow.failure_boundary: Revision conflict, invalid configuration, or stale selection is rejected rather than silently replaced.

workflow.action: Review estimates, bounded limits, offline or provider state, and unavailable authority before admission.
workflow.failure_boundary: Provider, credential, budget, or unavailable capability state cannot fall back to a different execution mode.

workflow.action: Start a typed manual run through coordinator-owned admission.
workflow.failure_boundary: Malformed, stale, conflicting, or unauthorized admission requests fail before a run is created.

workflow.action: Observe bounded progress, time, cost, failures, coverage gaps, and explicit unavailable state.
workflow.failure_boundary: Presentation state cannot rewrite coordinator progress, costs, failures, gaps, or terminal truth.

workflow.action: Reload the renderer and reconnect or resynchronize from authoritative application state.

proofs.selector: three renderer reloads and authoritative resync measurements

workflow.failure_boundary: Lost events, stale sessions, or sequence gaps force a bounded authoritative resync instead of local replay as truth.

workflow.action: Open summary and readiness state, or explicit scope-limited status when readiness is unavailable.
workflow.failure_boundary: Absent report or readiness authority remains explicit and cannot be inferred from partial findings.

workflow.action: Page supported-case and lead-only queues through bounded deterministic keyset queries.
workflow.failure_boundary: Unsupported cases stay separate from lead-only queues; cursor, sort, filter, search, and size violations fail closed.

workflow.action: Open finding, case, report, evidence, provenance, and focused-mod details without presentation-side reinterpretation.

proofs.selector: typed finding, case, report, evidence, provenance, and source readback

workflow.failure_boundary: Unknown identities, wrong source relationships, hostile text, and unavailable details remain inert and explicit.

workflow.action: Append a revision-bound disposition or annotation and an assumption revision without mutating analysis truth.
workflow.failure_boundary: User state is append-only and revision-bound; conflicts, stale revisions, or insufficient carryover proof do not rewrite immutable analysis.

workflow.action: Request targeted verification through the five native-only RPCs while retaining exact scope, source, dependency, and correlation lineage.

proofs.selector: targeted verification begin, status, cancel, start, readback, recovery, migration, and tamper rejection

workflow.failure_boundary: The renderer has no targeted-verification mapping; incomplete lineage, unrelated readiness, tampering, or recursive requests fail closed.

workflow.action: Restart the shell or coordinator and prove durable authoritative readback and recovery.
workflow.failure_boundary: Interrupted attempts, stale sessions, and incomplete durable state are fenced or reported; the shell cannot become the recovery authority.

workflow.action: Create and inspect a local-private structured JSON export with exact selection, provenance, privacy, and source-policy evidence.

proofs.selector: structured export creation, inspection, source binding, and deletion

workflow.failure_boundary: Export stays local-private and structured; deletion removes only the export object and never mutates source analysis or user-state history.

workflow.action: Reject hostile, unknown, oversized, replayed, out-of-order, and stale operations across native, bridge, IPC, and desktop boundaries.

proofs.selector: replay, stale session, concurrency, message size, overflow, and cancellation rejection
origin, filesystem, browser override, navigation, and runtime policy rejection

workflow.failure_boundary: No generic path, command, URL, provider, credential, filesystem, native proxy, evaluator, private fixture, or semantic-oracle authority is reachable.
